question: What is the mean US population from 2013 to 2018?
Which series had the largest best-year value?
How did PRS30006032 Q01 change by year?

description: Q1. Mean and standard deviation of annual US population, 2013-2018. stddev_sample is the reported answer. One row.
Q2. One row per BLS series_id. best_year is the year with the largest quarterly sum, or Q05 if the series has no quarters. Latest year on a tie.
Q3. PRS30006032 Q01 value by year, left-joined to ACS population. Years with no population stay.

content: Use only the three gold SQL tables. Do not query bronze, silver, or the _pyspark tables. For Q1, report stddev_sample, not stddev_population. For Q2, year_value is already the best-year metric. For Q3, keep rows where population is null.

question: What is the mean US population from 2013 to 2018?
Which series had the largest best-year value?
sql:
SELECT series_id, series_title, best_year, year_value
FROM pr_population.gold.q2_series_best_year
ORDER BY year_value DESC
LIMIT 10

question: How did PRS30006032 Q01 change by year?
sql:
SELECT year, value, population
FROM pr_population.gold.q3_prs30006032_q01
ORDER BY year
